subject: DI03000081

body.en:
Understand the idea

Three alternating flux/current sets transfer balanced three-phase power through mutual induction at the same frequency.

Explanation and application

  • Each phase obeys Ephase=4.44fNΦmunder the sinusoidal assumption;connection converts phase quantities to line quantities.
  • For balanced input/output Srated=√3VLIL=3VphIph;real power includes the load pf.The√3shortcut is not a general unbalanced-power equation.
  • Athree-phase transformer is not a frequency converter and does not turn a single-phase source into balanced three-phase power by itself.
Dyn11meaning?

HVdelta,LVstar,LVneutral brought out;LVleads HV30°under the clock convention.

Definition

Three HV/LVwinding pairs may share a common magnetic structure rather than three separate cores.

Classification / representative type

  • Three single-phase bank versus single three-phase unit;core/shell and oil-filled/dry designs provide further classifications.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Three-limb laminated core carries one phase winding pair per limb;balanced phase fluxes sum approximately to zero in the shared yokes.
  2. Each limb has insulated LV/HVcoils with deliberate leakage/cooling clearances and mechanical bracing against short-circuit forces.
  3. Bushings and a terminal diagram identify winding ends,neutral availability and approved star/delta links;colours alone do not establish polarity.
  4. Oil-filled units use tank,insulating liquid and radiators;dry units use rated solid insulation and air ducts.
  5. Conservator/breather,pressure relief,Buchholz relay and temperature indicators are fitted only where the design calls for them;small sealed/dry units differ.
  6. Tap changer adjusts effective turns ratio;off-circuit taps require isolation,while OLTCoperation follows its approved operating scheme.
  7. Nameplate,earthing connections,protective devices and guarded clearance define installation limits and access procedures.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Balanced ACenergisation establishes three fluxes separated120electrical degrees.
  2. Each flux links its paired windings and induces voltage according to turns.
  3. The shared magnetic return paths carry the combined phase fluxes under the actual core geometry.
  4. Load connection draws secondary phase currents;primary current components provide balancing ampere-turns.
  5. Winding links determine line/phase ratios and phase displacement;winding polarity remains essential.
  6. Losses heat windings/core;the designed oil/air circulation transfers heat to the surroundings.
  7. Protection responds to faults,abnormal temperature/pressure or other design-specific conditions;maintenance is performed only under the approved safe system.

Applications

Power-system voltage conversion,distribution and plant supplies.

Limitations and safety

One failed phase of a single unit may remove the whole unit from service;never assume unrestricted open-delta reuse.

h.en: Bank versus integrated unit and cooling
h.gu: Bank સામે Integrated Unit તથા Cooling

body.en:
Understand the idea

Compare complete installed duty,not just purchase price.

Explanation and application

  • Abank uses three separately transportable single-phase units;spares and repair can be simpler,but footprint,connections and total material/cost may increase.
  • Asingle three-phase unit is often more compact and economical per kVA,but transport and complete-unit outage/replacement require planning.
  • ONAN:oil natural,air natural.ONAF:oil natural,air forced.OFAF:oil forced,air forced.OFWF:oil forced,water forced.Use the actual nameplate cooling designation.
  • Fans/pumps are not interchangeable rating upgrades:cooling-stage ratings,auxiliary supply,temperature limits and protection must be designed/approved.
  • Inspect leaks,breather condition,temperature trend,abnormal sound,terminals and records under isolation/access rules.Do not open oil fittings,vent pressure or touch live bushings as a student activity.

Understand the idea

The syllabus cites IS10028(Part1):1985for selection;use the applicable current authorised standards/specification for real procurement.

Explanation and application

  • Estimate maximum demand,load diversity,growth,daily load curve,kVAand pf;choose voltage ratio,frequency,phase number and required tapping range.
  • Distribution duty often stays energised over24hours with variable/light load,so core loss and all-day efficiency are important;this is a duty distinction,not a universal size boundary.
  • Power-transformer duty may emphasise high-load efficiency/system transfer capacity;use the actual load cycle rather than assuming every unit runs continuously at full load.
  • Check impedance/fault level,insulation/impulse withstand,earthing/vector group,parallel compatibility,ambient/altitude,cooling and indoor/outdoor/fire requirements.
  • Include reliability,spare strategy,maintenance access,noise,loss capitalisation,protection and tap control.Select certified equipment with manufacturer/system-engineer review.
  • These are educational selection headings,not quoted numeric acceptance limits or a claim that every historical clause is current.

title.en: 4.4 Yy/Dd/Dy/Yd,vector groups,open delta and Scott connection
title.gu: 4.4 Star/Delta,Vector Groups,Open Delta તથા Scott Connection

body.en:
Understand the idea

Let a=N1/N2per phase and assume balanced operation.

Explanation and application

  • Yy:VL1/VL2=a;IL1/IL2≈1/aideally.Star neutral is available only if brought out;zero-sequence/harmonic behaviour depends on core and earthing.
  • Dd:VL1/VL2=a;delta provides a path for appropriate triplen/zero-sequence circulating components but has no inherent external neutral.
  • Dy:VL1/VL2=a/√3;Yd:VL1/VL2=√3a.Current ratios are inverse line-voltage ratios in the ideal balanced power model.
  • Mixed star/delta normally introduces an odd30°clock displacement,depending on polarity/phase pairing.Do not assign a clock number from Dy/Ydletters alone.
  • The source cites IS2026(PartIV):1977terminal markings,tappings/connections;learn the labelled winding ends and actual connection diagram,not an unverified generic link recipe.

Understand the idea

Follow each phase winding and distinguish its voltage from the line-pair voltage.

Explanation and application

  • The drawn topology labels winding groups;terminal polarity and phase pairing must still be verified before a clock group or real connection is declared.

Understand the idea

Follow each phase winding and distinguish its voltage from the line-pair voltage.

Explanation and application

  • The drawn topology labels winding groups;terminal polarity and phase pairing must still be verified before a clock group or real connection is declared.

Understand the idea

Follow each phase winding and distinguish its voltage from the line-pair voltage.

Explanation and application

  • The drawn topology labels winding groups;terminal polarity and phase pairing must still be verified before a clock group or real connection is declared.

Understand the idea

HVreference is at12;LVposition defines clockwise lag in30°steps,modulo360°.

Explanation and application

  • Dyn11:D=HVdelta,y=LVstar,n=LVneutral brought out;clock11means330°lag,equivalently30°lead.Dyn1means30°lag.
  • Use corresponding line-voltage phasors and declared phase labels;do not compare an HVline voltage to an LVphase voltage and inadvertently add30°.
  • Capital Ndenotes a brought-out HVneutral;lowercase ndenotes LVneutral.The source writes Ynd1;verify the actual nameplate,commonly YNd1when the HVneutral is brought out.Aphase-sequence indicator identifies sequence,not clock displacement by itself.Use approved vector-group/phase-angle equipment or the authorised low-voltage test method with terminal/polarity identification.
  • Vector-group mismatch can produce severe circulating current in parallel service even if ratios match;dead checks and qualified approval precede energisation.

Understand the idea

Two suitably rated single-phase units can supply a three-phase load in an approved open-delta bank.

Explanation and application

  • If each unit is rated Sunit,the balanced bank limit is√3Sunit,not2Sunit.At equal line/load conditions each unit reaches its own kVAlimit.
  • Compared with a former closed-delta bank of3Sunit,this is1/√3=57.735%.Utilisation relative to the two installed units is√3/2=86.603%.
  • Example:100kVAper unit gives300kVAclosed delta but173.205kVAopen delta,not200kVA.Do not assume one winding of an integrated three-phase transformer can simply be removed to obtain this bank.

Understand the idea

Scott uses main and teaser transformers to obtain two equal secondary voltages90°apart from a balanced three-phase source.

Explanation and application

  • Construction:main primary spans B–Cwith a centre tap M;teaser primary spans A–M.The two secondaries are separate phase windings with specified equal output turns.
  • In balanced geometry,Mis the electrical midpoint of B–C;VAM=(√3/2)VBCin magnitude and is90°from VBC.
  • Equal volts per turn therefore require teaser primary turns Nt=(√3/2)Nm≈0.866025Nm.With equal secondary turns,equal output voltages result.
  • The main centre tap carries teaser-related current as well as main phase action;winding current/rating must be designed for the connection,not inferred from two ordinary nameplates.
  • Balanced equal two-phase loads at the stated pfproduce balanced three-phase input currents ideally.Unbalanced secondary loading causes input unbalance.
  • Example:Nm1000turns requires Nt866.025ideal turns;practical integer turns/design corrections are selected by the manufacturer.Applications include appropriate two-phase supply conversion,not DCgeneration.

Understand the idea

Parallel units improve capacity,continuity and maintenance flexibility only when compatible.

Explanation and application

  • Essential voltage compatibility:equal ratio/tap position,correct polarity,same frequency,same phase sequence and matching phase displacement/vector group.
  • Compatible percentage impedances give proportional kVAsharing;similar X/Rratios give compatible active/reactive sharing and pf.For exact sharing,use complex impedances on the same base.
  • With equal secondary no-load EMFs,E−V=I1Z1=I2Z2so I1/I2=Z2/Z1.Ratio mismatch causes circulating current approximately(E1−E2)/(Z1+Z2),even at external no load.
  • Example:100kVAand200kVAunits with equal percentage Zand angle share150kVAload as50/100kVA.Unequal percentage impedances can overload one unit before total nameplate kVAis reached.
  • Never use live trial-and-error phase swapping or direct paralleling as a compatibility test.The approved dead-check/test-instrument procedure and protection are mandatory.

Aim / official status

Three-phase transformer parts

Compulsory(*)in source;no individual duration is provided.

Instruments and connections

  • Inspect a dead guarded unit/model and manufacturer diagram;identify HV/LVbushings,neutral,earthing,nameplate and cooling accessories actually present.
  • Use appropriate rated meters,power/phase instruments where required,tachometer/guards for rotating tests and the approved trainer manual.No actual experiment is claimed.

Procedure:qualified-supervised only

  1. Identify ratings,terminals,limits and emergency stop;prepare a signed-off circuit/instrument plan before power.
  2. Isolate,verify dead and inspect guards,earthing,protection and leads.All links/range changes follow the approved safe procedure.
  3. Inspect a dead guarded unit/model and manufacturer diagram;identify HV/LVbushings,neutral,earthing,nameplate and cooling accessories actually present.
  4. Trace core/coil arrangement and external accessories;record type,material/function and condition without opening oil tanks or approaching live terminals.
  5. Record only genuine readings with units,ranges,conditions and uncertainty;leave unperformed observations blank.Expected examples are not actual data.
  6. Use the prescribed shutdown sequence;keep required field/load protection until the machine is safely stopped,then isolate/verify dead and discharge stored energy before access.

Calculations and interpretation

Tabulate each part and function;calculate rated line current from√3VLonly under balanced nameplate rating.

Safe fault-finding

Oil leaks,abnormal indicators,damaged bushings or missing earth connections require qualified maintenance,not student repair.

Precautions

  • No unguarded rotation,no unloaded series motor,no open running shunt field,no rated-voltage SCtest,no live rewiring and no bypassed protections.
  • Variac/autotransformer is not isolation;earth-referenced scope grounds are common/PE.Never lift PEor float a mains oscilloscope;use approved rated differential/isolated-input methods where needed.

body.en: Compare Dyn11/Ynd1using corresponding line phasors and approved phase-angle/vector-group measurements;phase sequence indication alone cannot establish clock displacement.
Use total three-phase real input/output power and balanced assumptions where√3formulas apply;state winding reference,load pf,losses and measurement uncertainty.
Use phasor/simulation analysis to compare four-wire neutral current with three-wire floating-star displacement;earth is not a substitute neutral connection.

This source project concerns a suitable three-phase MOTORstarter,not DCmotor starting or transformer vector-group change by itself.Use a protected logic/training model;motor winding ratings,interlocking and approved changeover remain essential.
Verify the main centre tap,Nt/Nm=√3/2,equal secondary magnitudes and90°displacement using rated trainer/phase instruments;report balanced/unbalanced load limits.
Plan approved loading within each phase rating and compare output/(output+loss)across declared load fractions;do not extrapolate a small trainer test as power-system certification.
